item.title: GBP/USD holds gains above 1.3650 as BoE rate decision looms
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gains momentum to around 1.3685 during the early European session on Tuesday. The Pound Sterling (GBP) gathers strength against the Greenback on the cautiously hawkish stance of the Bank of England (BoE). All eyes will be on the BoE interest rate decision later on Thursday.

item.title: GBP/JPY flat lines below 213.00 as intervention fears benefit JPY; bears seem hesitant
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross is seen oscillating in a narrow band near a one-and-a-half-week top, touched during the Asian session this Tuesday, and currently trading around the 212.70-212.75 region, nearly unchanged for the day.

item.title: Japanese Yen sticks to positive bias vs. USD as intervention fears offset fiscal concerns
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) remains on the front foot against a mildly softer US Dollar (USD) through the Asian session on Tuesday as comments from Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama revive fears about a joint US-Japan intervention.

item.title: Gold clings to gains above $4,800 as softer USD offsets easing geopolitical tensions
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on the previous day's bounce from the $4,400 neighborhood, or the lowest level since January 6, and gains some follow-through traction during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: EUR/GBP trades with caution near five-month low of 0.8620, ECB-BoE policy in focus
item.description: The EUR/GBP pair trades vulnerably near the five-month low of 0.8620 during the early European trading session on Tuesday. The cross has come under pressure ahead of monetary policy announcements by both the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Bank of England (BoE) on Thursday.

item.title: EURUSD: Stabilization efforts amid upcoming ECB meeting – Scotiabank
item.description: The EUR is attempting to stabilize after last week's rally and pullback, with key fundamentals expected to emerge this week. The ECB's policy decision is anticipated to maintain a neutral outlook, while yields spreads are recovering, note Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret from Scotiabank.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Posts modest gains near 183.50, further consolidation cannot be ruled out
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross posts modest gains near 183.50 during the early European session on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains stronger as RBA raises Official Cash Rate
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) gains ground against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday following the Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) decision to raise the Official Cash Rate (OCR) by 25 basis points (bps) to 3.85% from 3.6%. The decision was widely expected by the market.

item.title: USD/INR sinks on US-India trade deal euphoria
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a strong note against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, following the confirmation of a long-awaited trade deal between the United States (US) and India the previous day. The USD/INR pair opens with a gap down to near 90.35, the lowest level seen in almost three weeks.

item.title: GBP/USD: Range-bound trading expected – UOB Group
item.description: The GBP/USD pair is anticipated to trade within a range between 1.3640 and 1.3710, following a recent decline. The outlook suggests that while downward momentum has eased, GBP is unlikely to decline further, note Quek Ser Leang, Senior Technical Strategist and Peter Chia, Senior FX Strategist at UOB
